title: Handy Tools Site Data
description: Single source of truth for tool metadata. Every tools.json entry must validate against this schema. Drives home grid, command palette, pack pages, and embed catalog.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking schema changes.

releaseVersion.description: Release identity mirrored in sw.js CACHE_VERSION (per AD-8). CI rejects divergence between the two.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which tools.json was last regenerated.

tools.description: Array of tool entries. Adding a tool requires only an entry here (and a folder).

packs.description: Optional object of pack entries (DC-0, Epic: Discovery Pack). Each pack is a sibling of `tools` and groups related quiz/recommendation experiences under a single route tree (e.g., packs.discovery hosts personality + recommendation quizzes). Packs are validated by scripts/pack-gate.py — independent of tool-contract-gate.py, so the existing 50 tool entries are unaffected.

slug.description: URL slug; kebab-case, immutable post-launch (UX-DR-8). Resolves to tools/<slug>/index.html.

title.description: Display name (English source of truth; translated per FR-17).

description.description: One-line description. Used in tool card, search match, pack card, and palette result (FR-5, UX-DR-11).

pack.description: Pack tag(s). A tool may appear in multiple packs. Empty array means tool is uncategorized (not allowed for ready=true).

icon.description: Inline SVG data-URL or path to icon asset under assets/icons/.

keywords.description: Search keywords (FR-5). Matched by the search engine alongside title and description.

last-updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last meaningful update to the tool (rendered on the tool page and used by FR-1's last-updated column).

ready.description: True iff score >= 8 with no expired waiver. Drives visibility in home grid, palette, pack pages, search, and embed catalog (AD-2).

score.description: Quality score 0-10 against the 10-criterion rubric (FR-1). ready=true requires score >= 8.

score-waiver.description: Structured waiver object (per AD-2 and AI-1 readiness fix). Allows a tool below 8/10 to ship with justification. Waivers expire after a configurable number of releases.

urlState.description: Per-tool URL state codec schema (AD-5). default is merged into decoded state on load; encode list maps form fields to URL hash keys; decode list maps URL hash keys back to form fields.

sample.description: Per-tool sample-data preset (AD-5 state preset). Each key is a form-field id; each value must match the type declared in `encode[]` for that field. Merged on top of `default` at runtime; absent fields fall back to default values. The merged object is frozen before return — see HT.sampleData.fill.

from.description: DOM field selector or input id. Omit if same as key.

to.description: DOM field selector or input id. Omit if same as key.

shortcuts.description: Per-tool keyboard shortcuts. Surfaced in the keyboard help overlay (Story 3.3) and globally via the command palette.

history-keys.description: Ordered list of input field ids that participate in the tool's history entry. Capped at 10 entries per tool (FR-12). Story 2.3 + 3.6: this array is one half of the hasHistory() AND-gate — a slug is eligible for history (HT.history.hasHistory(slug) === true) only if BOTH this array is non-empty AND the tool has a urlState block. When both conditions hold, HT.history.panel(slug, main) auto-mounts a sidebar (≥768px, with close button + backdrop per Story 3.6) or a sheet (<768px) showing the FIFO-capped last 50 entries (Story 3.6 raised from 10 per FR-12 + retention finding); entries carry relative timestamps via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(navigator.language, {numeric: 'auto'}), a <time datetime='ISO 8601'> element, and a body that joins the first 3 input values (clamped to 40 chars + U+2026) with ', '. HT.history.button(slug) returns a one-click affordance; HT.history.push/list/restore/clear/subscribe are exposed on the AD-14 frozen surface; the entry shape is {ts (ISO 8601 string), inputs, result} (legacy {id, ts number, state, result, label} entries are migrated in _readRaw).

tab-order-canonical.description: Canonical Tab order for the tool page — ordered list of CSS selectors (#id or tag.class) that HT.a11y.tabOrder(slug) should match at each position. Items are matched in order; any number of intervening runtime entries are tolerated. The machine-checkable surface is the 4-slot form ['#shell-skip', 'input', 'button', 'a'] which captures the spec's intent ('skip → inputs → actions (sample/reset/history) → result/footer'); finer-grained role labels (e.g., '#qr-sample', '#ls-reset') are encouraged as each Wave 2.6/2.7/2.8 migration adds its per-tool declaration. When absent, the gate falls back to the Story 2.4 canonical order and emits a warn recommending this per-tool declaration be added.

view-source.description: Trust surface (FR-16). Every tool footer links to its source.

embed-snippet.description: Embed mode settings (FR-10, Story 4.1). badge-default controls the 'Powered by handy.tools' link; min-width/min-height enforce the per-B3 a11y minimum of 240x240. Read by `HT.share.embedCode(slug)` (Story 2.5) to build the `<iframe>` snippet returned by the Share dialog's Embed Code section; missing/empty → embedCode returns '' and the dialog hides the section.

search-priority.description: Integer 0-10; higher values are ranked higher in the search engine (Story 1.11). Default is 5.

legacy.description: Brownfield flag (AD-15). True if the tool folder pre-dates the new contract. Populated by docs/tool-inventory.md.

migrated.description: Brownfield flag (AD-15). True if the tool has been promoted to the new contract. Inverse of legacy for migrated tools.

pack-entry.description: A pack is a sibling of `tools` and groups related experiences (quiz / recommendation / game) under one route tree + one Shell loader. The pack itself is gated by scripts/pack-gate.py — NOT tool-contract-gate.py. Each pack entry declares its loader script and an ordered list of quiz/recommendation entries.

slug.description: Pack slug; kebab-case. Resolves to /packs/<slug>/ in the route tree.

title.description: Display name. Surfaced on the pack landing page.

description.description: One-line description of the pack. Surfaced under the title.

loader.description: Path to the pack's bootstrap module. Loaded on first navigation into the pack route tree (Story 4b Proxy-factory pattern).

score-waiver.description: Per-pack waiver (mirror of tool-entry score-waiver). Allows a pack below the gate threshold to ship with justification. Same shape + expiry rules as tool-side waiver.

entries.description: Ordered list of quiz / recommendation entries that belong to this pack. Each entry is a thin content declaration (data.json + route file), NOT bespoke code — the Shell modules (HT.scoring, HT.results, HT.challenge, HT.recommend) own the runtime.

quiz-entry.description: One quiz / personality / recommendation experience inside a pack. The entry declares what content to load (data.json), how to score it, and which Shell modules to mount (modules[]).

description.description: One-line description. Surfaced on the pack grid card.

category.description: Quiz category — viral | utility | game. Drives the pack grid layout and lane prioritization.

emoji.description: Hero emoji for the pack grid card.

data.description: Path to the quiz's data.json — the single source of truth for questions, traits, archetypes, share-card copy, and challenge spec. Relative to the pack route directory.

ready.description: True iff score >= 8 with no expired waiver (mirror of tool-entry semantics; gated by pack-gate.py).

modules.description: Closed set of Shell modules the quiz mounts. The kind enum is closed — adding a new kind is a schema-major bump. At least 'scoring' + 'results' are required for any quiz; viral + multiplayer-style quizzes also declare 'challenge'; recommendation quizzes also declare 'catalog'.

module-def.description: Discriminated union (DC-0, Epic: Discovery Pack). `kind` is the closed enum; `config` is a per-kind object validated against the matching config schema in this $defs block.

config.description: Per-kind config. Validated against scoring-config / results-config / challenge-config / catalog-config by the matching `kind`. Schema-1 validates only shape; pack-gate.py validates semantic correctness (e.g., catalog-config.domain matches an actual loaded catalog).

scoring-config.description: Configuration for an HT.scoring mount. The spec lives in data.json; this object only declares the trait IDs the scoring spec is expected to surface (smoke gate cross-check).

trait-ids.description: Ordered list of trait ids the scoring spec is expected to surface. The pack-gate cross-checks this list against `data.json` at validation time.

default-archetype.description: Archetype id used when no `ifMin`/`ifMax` rule matches. Must match an archetype id in data.json.

results-config.description: Configuration for an HT.results mount. Declares the result-card visual variant and the contrarian (unexpected trait) line policy.

variant.description: Result-card visual variant. Drives the card chrome (emoji / bars / contrarian).

trait-cap.description: Max number of trait bars shown on the card. Default 4. Bars beyond the cap are summarized in a single line.

show-contrarian.description: Render the 'unexpected trait' line. Recommended true for viral quizzes; false for utility/recommendation.

challenge-config.description: Configuration for an HT.challenge mount. Declares the comparison policy and the match-scorer used to compute friend agreement.

match-scorer.description: Algorithm used to compare self vs about-other-user answers.

expiry-days.description: Days until a Challenge-a-Friend link expires. Default 30.

show-axis-bars.description: When true, the comparison view shows one bar per scored trait (you vs them). When false, shows only the headline score.

catalog-config.description: Configuration for an HT.recommend + HT.catalog mount. Declares which catalog the recommendation quiz matches against and the prose-template paths used for explain().

domain.description: Catalog domain identifier. Must match a key in catalog-profiles.json.

catalog-path.description: Path to the catalog JSON (relative to assets/data/). Default: <domain>.json.

prose-path.description: Optional path to a per-domain prose-stubs file (relative to assets/data/recommend-prose/). When absent, explain() falls back to a templated string.

top-n.description: Number of alternatives shown alongside the top match. Default 3.
